title: Alekgator's Rubix Pack
description: This texture pack which is in progress, adds new rubix cube like texture to weapons such as netherite swords, maces, carts, and soon to be much more. I hope y'all can enjoy this texture pack as much as I do.
body: Makes Minecraft Weapons. . . Um. . . Well. . . . . . . . . . apear as rubix cubes. It textures the Mace, Netherite Sword, and TNT Minecart, I am working on more versions of the texture pack that will add Bows, Crossbows, Armor, and other PvP essentials.
